comment: HS 841459 ('fans, other') matches the core declared line: the group's main output is industrial axial/centrifugal/jet ventilation fans, which fall in 8414.59 — exact match for the fan line. However the declaration covers only fans, while the published product range also includes damper systems, MODULBYP, mobile work platforms, electrical controls & instrumentation and mining equipment, which sit outside 8414 (likely 8479/8537/8428 or similar) — these lines are missing from the declaration. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the actual end-markets are mining, tunnels/metro, marine and wind tunnels; oil & gas/chemicals is at most a marginal application, not the industry. No customs line was available to this check, so the actual export/import HS codes used by the Indian entity are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'; the 841459 mapping is derived from the group's published product catalogue, not from a shipment record. Per project rule 3, the partial mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, code kept as 841459 for the fan line with the additional lines noted above.
